newsitem.title: USA: Shuffle Master expands board to 7 members.
newsitem.headline: Shuffle Master expands board to 7 members.

text.p: Shuffle Master Inc said Tuesday it named Pat Cruzen, a former Grand Casinos Inc executive, to its board, increasing the number of directors to seven from six.
The company's board was reduced to six from seven in March when one director declined to stand for election, a Shuffle Master spokesman said.
Cruzen, a 25-year veteran of the gaming industry, runs his own consulting firm, Cruzen & Assoc., based in Minneapolis. Before that he was president and chief operating officer of Grand Casinos.

"We are delighted to add an individual with the industry experience and expertise of Pat Cruzen to our board of directors. His knowledge of casino operations and industry trends will provide us invaluable insight and direction as we manage our significant and unique growth opportunities," Joseph Lahti, Shuffle Master's president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Shuffle Master specializes in providing innovative products and services to the casino industry.
